decisions.reason: A consumer superfood drink mix is far from the firm's core waste-to-value engineering focus, and with no visible traction since 2019 a shortfall against aspiration would trigger reallocating scarce resources to the technology ventures.
Modular plant extensions complement the flagship waste-to-energy plants and cost little to keep offering, so the firm can carry them despite uncertain results.
WASTX Oil is a publicly launched flagship central to the firm's identity and direction, so management will tolerate uncertain early results rather than abandon it.
The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is a strategic flagship in a growing field, and its long development horizon justifies continued commitment of the firm's reinvested resources.
